prompt: Which three actions will you take, starting now, to be more assertive at work?

criteria.label: At least three different actions.
criteria.met: You list three or more different actions.
criteria.unsure: It's unclear whether these are three different actions. Put each on its own line.

criteria.label: A colleague could see or hear each action.
criteria.short: actions a colleague could see or hear
criteria.met: A colleague could see or hear these actions.
criteria.missed: Say what you will do, such as "I will say no when my week is full", rather than how you want to feel.
criteria.unsure: It's unclear what a colleague would see or hear. Say what you'll say or do.

criteria.label: At least one action names a time or situation.
criteria.met: You name a time or situation.
criteria.missed: Add a time or situation, such as "at Monday’s team meeting".
criteria.unsure: It's unclear when you'll act. Name a day, meeting or situation.

criteria.label: You commit to taking these actions yourself.
criteria.missed: Write what you will do. "My manager should listen more" isn't your action.
criteria.unsure: It's unclear who will act. Start each action with "I will".
